# The Site Supervisor

> HAZWOPER leadership training: 8-hour supervisor course under 29 CFR 1910.120(e)(4), supervisor refresher, (q) incident command and HAZWOPER train-the-trainer certification.

The Site Supervisor (https://supervisor.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Supervisor Training, (q) Incident Command, Supervisor Refresher, Train-the-Trainer training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://supervisor.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Supervisor Training](https://supervisor.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-supervisor-training): $69.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e)(4). The 8 additional hours of specialized training that HAZWOPER supervisors need under 1910.120(e)(4). Enroll: https://supervisor.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-supervisor-training?buy=597
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER (q) Incident Command Training](https://supervisor.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-q-incident-command-training): $199.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q). Incident command training for HAZWOPER emergency response under 29 CFR 1910.120(q). Enroll: https://supervisor.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-q-incident-command-training?buy=593
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Supervisor Refresher Training](https://supervisor.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-supervisor-refresher-training): $69.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e)(4)/(e)(8). The annual 8-hour refresher for HAZWOPER supervisors. Enroll: https://supervisor.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-supervisor-refresher-training?buy=596

Become a qualified in-house HAZWOPER trainer for your organization. Enroll: https://supervisor.hazwoperosha.us/courses/hazwoper-train-the-trainer-certification?buy=1016

## Guides

- [The supervisor's eight hours: what 1910.120(e)(4) adds](https://supervisor.hazwoperosha.us/guides/hazwoper-supervisor-eight-hours): Why a foreman with a 40-hour card still isn't trained to supervise, and what the extra hours are for.
- [Writing a site safety and health plan your crew will actually use](https://supervisor.hazwoperosha.us/guides/site-safety-and-health-plan): OSHA lists what the plan must contain. Making it useful in the field is the supervisor's job.
- [Becoming an in-house HAZWOPER trainer](https://supervisor.hazwoperosha.us/guides/becoming-an-in-house-hazwoper-trainer): What OSHA requires of trainers, when bringing training in-house pays off, and what records you'll need.
